title: Sync state
description: Contents of ol-sync. Device-local: never uploaded, never backed up. Contains a GitHub token in plain localStorage, so treat it as a secret.

token.description: Fine-grained GitHub PAT with Contents read/write on the data repo. Presence of a token is what enables sync.

lastSync.description: Epoch ms of the last successful reconciliation.

dirty.description: Local changes are queued for the next sync.

error.description: Last user-facing error message. '' when healthy.
